## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō guāngmíng tóngzǐ yīnyuán jīng* (T549) is a four-fascicle Sòng sūtra translated by Shīhù 施護 ([施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)). The protagonist *Guāngmíng tóngzǐ* 光明童子 ("Boy Light-Brilliance") is the central figure of an *avadāna* tracing his karmic causes leading to encounter with the Buddha.

**Abstract**

A four-fascicle Mahāyāna *avadāna* on the child-bodhisattva *Prabhākumāra*. Translation dated to Shīhù's productive period (989–1017 CE).
